choices.title: Kuhl core desktop
choices.description: Fedora-packaged Niri, Waybar, Fuzzel, Kitty, Mako, wallpapers, screen lock and essential XWayland/portal integration. Leaves GNOME installed as fallback.

choices.title: Kuhl Day / Dusk appearance
choices.description: Install coordinated Kuhl colors, wallpapers, terminal, bar, notifications and Niri theme includes. Switch later with kuhl theme day or kuhl theme dusk.

choices.title: Replace existing desktop settings (with backups)
choices.description: For upgrading an existing Niri/Kuhl setup. Back up then replace current Niri, Waybar, Kitty, Mako and launcher configurations. Off by default; requires typing REPLACE before changes.

choices.title: Vicinae Spotlight-style search (optional COPR)
choices.description: Advanced macOS/Raycast-style search, file index and clipboard tools. REQUIRES explicit consent to enable third-party COPR quadratech188/vicinae. Without this, Super+Space opens Fedora-packaged Fuzzel.

choices.title: Network, Bluetooth and audio helpers
choices.description: NetworkManager tray applet, Blueman Bluetooth interface, pavucontrol, brightnessctl and playerctl. Makes a standalone Niri session friendlier.

choices.title: Flatseal
choices.description: Inspect and edit Flatpak sandbox permissions. Uses Flathub for current user only.

choices.title: Pika Backup
choices.description: Graphical encrypted backups. Uses Flathub for current user only.
